micro_interview.question: You have a model whose cross-validation score improves after adding many correlated features, but its out-of-sample performance deteriorates. What hypotheses would you test first, and how would you design experiments to distinguish between them?
micro_interview.demonstrate: Statistical reasoning, leakage awareness, overfitting diagnosis, experimental design, feature dependence and disciplined validation.
micro_interview.practice: Take 7 minutes to structure hypotheses and tests on paper, then give a 3-minute English answer. Prioritize what you would test first and explain why; do not jump directly to a favourite modelling technique.
